## Why it matters internationally

IETcc-CSIC has published an open dataset of visible reflectance, solar reflectance
and thermal emittance for 236 commercial façade, roof and pavement materials,
measured between 2023 and 2026 in the mateMad, PAULIA and ZEBAI projects. Its
thermo-optical work, begun in the mateMad project, includes peer-reviewed studies of
urban envelope materials in Madrid and of the reliability of portable in-situ
reflectance and emissivity measurements. IETcc researchers co-authored the
PaRaMetriC deliverable on reference techniques for emittance and reflectance of
passive radiative cooling materials, which includes intercomparisons of portable
instruments.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** solar and visible reflectance / absorptance · directional (20°, 60°) and hemispherical total thermal emittance · CIELAB colour coordinates
- **Spectral range:** Reflectance 380–1700 nm; thermal emittance from directional-hemispherical reflectance in six bands over 1.5–21 µm
- **Methodology:** Laboratory and in-situ characterisation of opaque urban and construction materials with portable fibre-optic spectrometers (solar and visible reflectance per UNE-EN 410) and a portable emissometer; includes studies of the reliability of portable in-situ measurements.
- **Named facilities:** Portable emissometer (directional-hemispherical reflectance, 1.5–21 µm) · Fibre-optic spectrometers with integrating sphere

**Application domains:** urban heat island mitigation and outdoor thermal comfort · building energy performance · façade, roof and pavement materials · passive radiative cooling (PaRaMetriC).

## IR-EMPOWER contributions

- IR-EMPOWER 2026: Pablo Alonso, “Emissivity Measurements of Construction Materials with Portable Equipment”
- IR-EMPOWER 2026: Gloria Pérez, “Catalogue of Thermo-Optical Properties of Construction Materials”
